method: C1 = (1 - w) * 4A + w * 1A, clipped at 0, per cell/month, at 1deg and 0.25deg; w = w_season in fire-season months of the region, w_off otherwise

C1.season_rule: month is fire season if whole-region Aqua 2003-2011 total of that calendar month >= season_share * annual total (all 9 years pooled). predict() recomputes it from view.history_counts('Aqua', region, 'region') for ANY region, seen or unseen; the state's `season` is only the fit-time copy for the 3 tuning regions

m4.table_axes: [calendar month 1..12, day/night (0=D, 1=N)]; value = Aqua-per-SNPP ratio (multiplies SNPP count of that month and day/night)

m1.region_index_note: model['a'][i] is the intercept of regions_fit[i]; slopes model['b'] are shared

standalone_4A.table_axes: [calendar month 1..12, day/night (0=D, 1=N)]; value = Aqua-per-SNPP ratio (multiplies SNPP count of that month and day/night)

standalone_1A.region_index_note: model['a'][i] is the intercept of regions_fit[i]; slopes model['b'] are shared

predict_rules.4A: tab = table_by_region[region] if region in the 3 tuning regions else pooled_table; pred = SNPP_day_count * tab[:,0] + SNPP_night_count * tab[:,1], clipped >= 0
predict_rules.1A: if region in regions_fit: p = logistic(model, region intercept a[i]), k = per_det_by_region[region], m = miss_by_region[region]; else pooled_model (a[0]), pooled_per_det, pooled_miss. Per footprint expected = max(k*p + m, 0); summed into grid cells
predict_rules.unseen_region: pooled rules in 4A and 1A; C1 weights are global; season is recomputed from that region's history
